mission.name: It Begins 1
mission.desc: A warlord is attempting to overthrow the local democratic government. Put the rebellion down.

line.text: Commander, we're responding to a rebel threat in Argentina.
So you're the new hotshot? Show us what you've got.

mission.name: It Begins 2
mission.desc: The warlord's base has been located.

line.text: I've decrypted The Watchtower's transmissions-
Havoc has fallen. A new dawn rises!
It'll have to wait! Armored enemies inbound!

mission.name: Hard Shell 1
mission.desc: Havoc carriers have been brought down all across the world!

line.text: The board has gone dark, Commander.
They've knocked out the Watchtower!
They're on the deck of the carrier!
Behold the power of the Shattered Sun!
Lay down your weapons, Havoc. You've lost.
Commander, Rezin is deploying units with Blitz. They can attack immediately!
Hold the line - don't let them break through!

mission.name: Thorn 1
mission.desc: These forces are being led by Rezin.

line.text: The last remaining Havoc carrier. I will blow you out of the sky.
She's in league with the scum that attacked us!
Long live Shattered Sun!
Still you resist? The pain will only last longer.

mission.name: Shattered Sun 1
mission.desc: There is an old Havoc base around here...

line.text: There is an old Havoc command center nearby, sir. I may be able to get it online.

mission.name: Shattered Sun 2
mission.desc: Shattered Sun continues to press their attack!

mission.name: Shattered Sun 3
mission.desc: I've almost got these computers online...

line.text: Almost...
Shattered Sun! Burn this place to the ground!

mission.name: Fire Rises 1
mission.desc: Rampant wildfires are slowing our progress.

line.text: It's hard to pilot through all this smoke.
What is that? Down there?

mission.name: Fire Rises 2
mission.desc: There are traces of synthetic chemicals in the smoke.

line.text: Who would do this? Test weapons on helpless people...

mission.name: Fire Rises 3
mission.desc: The weapons causing the fires is just ahead.

line.text: You're the survivors of Havoc? Heh. You'll still burn.

mission.name: Fire Rises 4
mission.desc: Vile's weapon tests must be stopped.

line.text: I'll roast you alive!
Stay back! I'm warning you! I'll blow this whole place sky high!
You're ours now, Vile.

mission.name: Broken Coast 1
mission.desc: I'm picking up a faint Havoc SOS.

line.text: We're receiving signals from another Havoc carrier. Maybe it survived the attack!

mission.name: Broken Coast 2
mission.desc: I'm picking up a faint Havoc SOS.

mission.name: Broken Coast 3
mission.desc: I'm picking up a faint Havoc SOS.

line.text: Damn! It was shot down as well.
Sensors are picking up movement.
Vultures. Raiders trying to find Havoc tech.

mission.name: Broken Coast 4
mission.desc: I'm picking up a faint Havoc SOS.

mission.name: Broken Coast 5
mission.desc: I'm picking up a faint Havoc SOS.

line.text: Charges are placed. We'll detonate this wreck.

mission.name: Shrapnel 1
mission.desc: Rezin has made contact with the scavs and is selling Havoc info.

line.text: The downed carrier was missing its memory core. The secrets it has are priceless.
We need to find it.

mission.name: Shrapnel 2
mission.desc: Rezin has made contact with the scavs and is selling Havoc info.

line.text: We're getting closer to the the memory core. If we can get within range I can wipe it.

mission.name: Shrapnel 3
mission.desc: Rezin has made contact with the scavs and is selling Havoc info.

mission.name: Shrapnel 4
mission.desc: Rezin has made contact with the scavs and is selling Havoc info.

line.text: You're too late, Havoc. We've sold the memory core and its secrets for a very high price.
Forget her! We need to find that core!

mission.name: Shrapnel 5
mission.desc: Rezin has made contact with the scavs and is selling Havoc info.

line.text: Elia has found the core. We need to draw off these mercenaries to give her a chance to wipe it.

line.text: You may win this day, but we will return!
Darius, are you alright?
I'm fine...its just...
Darius!
Darius has been poisoned, Commander. He needs treatment immediately.
I'm working on a cure, but Shattered Sun must've smelled an opportunity to attack.
I'm close, Commander. I just need a little more time.

Why are the lights flickering?
Something may be wrong with environmental systems. I'll take a look.
We just dropped two hundred feet!
What's going on?
I'm not sure, but if we don't figure it out we may crash!

Scouts have reported that Vile is testing new weapons in this region.
Have you come to act as moving targets? Excellent!
I'll see you burn!

line.text: Oh no. I recognize these readings from South America.
The kill satellite that brought down the other carrier is locked onto us!
That laser?
Yes.
Now I will stomp you out forever.
Vargas controls the killsat. We need to block his transmission or he'll blow us out of the sky.
You've blocked my signal? Then I'll kill you myself.
This ends now. Havoc falls.
Not today.

line.text: We received trace electrostatic signals matching the kill sat, from this location.
Meaning we might discover who attacked us here...
This used to be an old Havoc bunker.
Codenamed Arclight. Looks like it was repurposed by Shattered Sun.
Could this be where they obtained the codes for the kill sat?
They've also repurposed the bunker's defenses! Take cover!
It looks like they've been here for a while.
They must've been waiting to make their move for some time...

line.text: *Kzzt* Come in...this is commander Kara...
Kara is alive! We need to reach her as fast as possible.
If we recieved that signal, so did Shattered Sun...

line.text: She's right below the rubble
Let's finish this and get out of here.
The fires will consume you!
Vile's reign of terror needs to be stopped.
I can put him six feet in the ground-
No. We can use him as a source of information.
If you can't stand the heat, stay away from the flamethrower.
Vile uses a super flammable gel that allows his weapons to burn through steel.
You're coming with us, Vile.
Try your best!
We have our orders. Bring them down.
Vargas has put a large bounty on our heads.
Every mercenary is going to be aiming to collect.
No survivors.
Don't let them get access to the control deck!
We've almost repelled them! Focus fire!
We're getting a distress call from a fishing village. Let's check it out.
These pirates have been outfitted with Shatterd Sun tech.
They more than likely scavanged the parts.
Don't underestimate the pirates. It looks like they saved their big guns for last.
We need to be careful. Wait for the right time to strike.
Hold the line, we've almost won!
We will be victorious where Vargas has failed.
Intel reports that Eclipse is a splinter group of Shattered Sun.
Great. More people that want us dead.
Give us the carrier, and we will spare your lives.
Eclipse units incoming!
We will complete our mission.
Use the laser to mow down our targets!
Use the Earthshakers!
Finish them off!
Charge the lasers!
Finish them off!
Don't give them a chance!
Finish them off!
Shut down their weapons!
Don't let them escape!
Don't give them a chance!

We've found a broken core. We'll need to secure it, but I can repair it.
We've found the broken core!
Stop them! Keep the tech out of their hands!
I've manged to get the core online, but we'll need a target program.
Use the targeting program against them!
We're close now! The Havoc core is almost functional!
